documentation_gaps.title: testing文档缺少requirements-dev.txt安装的镜像源注意事项
documentation_gaps.body: testing文档说启动容器后pip install -r requirements-dev.txt,但未说明pre-commit可能从清华源403、需配置镜像源或换源; UT依赖安装可能因网络失败阻塞

documentation_gaps.title: main分支nightly镜像与最新main代码的vllm版本可能不匹配
documentation_gaps.body: nightly-main镜像内vllm 0.28.0 nightly与main分支代码存在细微版本差,导致spec_decode/extract_hidden_states等9个collection error和30个UT失败; 文档未说明main分支验证时需同步更新vllm到verified commit

documentation_gaps.title: 容器nproc显示1但实际可用256核
documentation_gaps.body: Docker 18.09 + cgroup v1下容器nproc显示1,但Cpus_allowed_list为0-255; 构建并发需手动指定MAX_JOBS而非依赖nproc

problems_encountered.problem: git clone GitHub仓库在本地和远程机器均超时失败(Empty reply from server)
problems_encountered.solution: 从镜像内复制已有代码(/vllm-workspace/vllm-ascend)到/workspace, 再git pull origin main更新; 镜像内代码为nightly构建时的main快照

problems_encountered.problem: 构建vllm-ascend时CMakeCache.txt路径不匹配(/workspace vs /vllm-workspace),因从镜像内复制代码时残留旧缓存
problems_encountered.solution: 构建前清理csrc/build目录(rm -rf csrc/build csrc/build_aclnn.out build *.egg-info)后重新pip install -e .成功

problems_encountered.problem: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt失败: pre-commit从清华源下载403 Forbidden; pytest被升级到9.1.1与triton-ascend(要求pytest==8.3.2)不兼容
problems_encountered.solution: 换阿里云源单独安装UT必需依赖(pytest-mock/asyncio==0.24.0/cov/scipy/ninja), pin pytest==8.3.2

problems_encountered.problem: 30个UT失败+9个collection error,主要因main分支代码引用了镜像内vllm 0.28.0 nightly版本尚未提供的模块/接口
problems_encountered.solution: 用--continue-on-collection-errors跳过collection error继续运行; 记录失败详情; 3989/4086用例通过(97.7%)
